solution: Write each term with the tangent addition formula. Let $t=\\tan x$. Then $\\tan(x+60^{\\circ})=\\frac{t+\\sqrt{3}}{1-\\sqrt{3}t}$ and $\\tan(x+120^{\\circ})=\\frac{t-\\sqrt{3}}{1+\\sqrt{3}t}$. Their sum simplifies to $\\frac{9t-t^{3}}{1-3t^{2}}$, and together with $\\tan x=t$ the left side equals $\\frac{3(3t-t^{3})}{1-3t^{2}}=3\\cdot\\frac{3t-t^{3}}{1-3t^{2}}=3\\tan 3x$ using $\\tan 3x=\\frac{3t-t^{3}}{1-3t^{2}}$.
hints: Combine over a common denominator and compare with $\\tan 3x$.
